title: HandoverReceipt
description: Proof that a vehicle moved from one party to another, signed by both sides. Needed at every physical transfer: roadside to recovery, recovery to depot, depot to transporter, transporter to garage, garage back to the driver. Held in the vehicle eVault so that the whole chain of custody sits in one place and can be read end to end, rather than in fragments across the five organisations that each held the vehicle for part of it.

vehicleEName.description: eName of the vehicle that changed hands

incidentEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the Incident, where the transfer is part of a case

jobEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the job under which the transfer happened, of the kind named in jobType

jobType.description: Kind of job named by jobEnvelopeId

transferPoint.description: Which step in the chain of custody this transfer is

fromPartyEName.description: eName of the organisation or person handing the vehicle over

fromPersonEName.description: The named person handing over. Absent only for an unattended collection.

toPartyEName.description: eName of the organisation or person taking the vehicle over

toPersonEName.description: eName of the named person taking the vehicle over, where toPartyEName is an organisation

address.description: Street address of the transfer, as a person would write it

conditionReportEnvelopeId.description: The condition the vehicle was in at the moment of transfer

keysTransferred.description: Whether the keys went with the vehicle

documentsTransferred.description: Registration papers, keys cards, service book, charging cables

belongingsTransferred.description: Personal belongings handed over or explicitly left in the vehicle

acknowledgements.description: Both sides. A receipt with one acknowledgement is an assertion, not proof.

byEName.description: eName of the person acknowledging the transfer

side.description: Which side of the transfer the person was on. driver is the vehicle's driver confirming, where they are neither side.

signature.description: The person's signature from their eID wallet, made through w3ds://sign

declined.description: True when the person refused to sign, for example because they dispute the vehicle's condition

declineReason.description: Why the person refused to sign

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
